a. [कृ-क्विप्] (Generally at the end of comp.) Accomplisher, doer, maker, performer, manufacturer, composer &c.; पाप°, पुण्य°, प्रतिमा° &c. -m 
__1 A class of affixes used to form derivatives (nouns, adjectives &c.) from roots. 
__2 A word so formed; कृद्ग्रहणे गतिकारकपूर्वस्यापि ग्रहणम् [[Pari. Śekh.]] 
-Comp. 
-अन्त a word ending with a kṛt affix. 
-लोपः the rejection of kṛt affixes.
P. (कृन्तति-कृत्त) To cut, cut off, divide, tear asunder, cut in pieces, destroy; प्रहरति विधिर्मर्मच्छेदी न कृन्तति जीवितम् [[

P. (कृणत्ति, कृत्त) 
__1 To spin. 
__2 To surround, encompass. 
__3 To attire.

€10U. (कीर्तयति-ते, कीर्तित) 
__1 To mention, repeat, utter; नाम्नि कीर्तित एव [[

]]; 2. 124. 
__2 To tell, recite, declare, communicate; सर्वं शृणुत तं विप्राः सम्यक् कीर्तयतो मम [[

p. p. [कृ-क्त] 
__1 Done, performed, made, effected accomplished, manufactured &c.; (p. p. of कृ 8. U. q. v.) ते करान् संप्रयच्छन्तु सुवर्णं च कृताकृतम् [[
]]; [Page0595-2] दिव्याः प्रसन्ना विविधाः सुराः कृतसुरा अपि [[

]]; natural and manufactured wines. 
__2 Wounded, hurt; सिद्धयेत ते कृतमनोभवधर्षितायाः [[

.]] 
__4 Cultivated; अकृतं च कृतात्क्षेत्राद् गौरजाविकमेव च [[

.]] 
__5 Appointed (as a duty); सोऽपि यत्नेन संरक्ष्यो धर्मो राजकृतश्च यः [[

.]] 
__6 Relating to, referring to; पतनीयकृते क्षेपे [[

.]] 
-तम् 
__1 Work, deed, action; कृतं न वेत्ति [[

.]] 
__2 Service, benefit. 
__3 Consequence, result. 
__4 Aim, object. 
__5 N. of that side of a die which is marked with four points; this is lucky; cf. [[

.]] 
__6 N. of the first of the four Yugas of the world extending over 1728000 years of men (see [[

]] and [[Kull.]] thereon). 
__7 The number ‘4’. 
__8 A stake at a game. 
__9 Prize or booty gained in a battle. 
__10 An offering. 
__11 Magic sorcery. 
-Comp. 
-अकृत a. done and not done; i. e. done in part but not completed; कृताकृतस्यैव च काञ्चनस्य [[Bu.
]]; that which is done and that which is not done (Dvandva Comp.) मा त्वा ताप्तां कृताकृते [[Mbh.]] on [[

.]] 
__2 numbered. 
(-ङ्कः) that side of a die which is marked with four points. 
-अञ्जलि a. folding the hands in supplication; प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत [[

.]] 
-अनुकर a. following another's example, subservient. 
-अनुसारः custom, usage. 
-अन्त a. bringing to an end, terminating. 
(-तः) 
__1 Yama, the god of death; कृतान्त आसीत्समरो देबानां सह दानवैः [[

.]] 
__2 fate, destiny; कृतान्त एव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत्प्रवासने [[
]]; क्रूरस्तस्मिन्नपि न सहते संगमं नौ कृतान्तः [[

.]] 
__3 a demonstrated conclusion, dogma, a proved doctrine; दैवं पुरुषकारश्च कृतान्तेनोपपद्यते [[
]]; यथा लौकिकेषु वैदिकेषु च कृतान्तेषु [[Mbh.]] on [[

.]] 
__4 a sinful or inauspicious action. 
__5 an epithet of Saturn. 
__6 Saturday. 
__7 the inevitable result of former actions. 
__8 the second lunar mansion. 
__9 the number ‘two’. °कुशल an astrologer; आधिराज्येऽभिषेको मे ब्राह्मणैः पतिना सह । कृतान्तकुशलैरुक्तं तत्सर्वं वितथीकृतम् [[

.]] °जनकः the sun. 
-अन्नम् 
__1 cooked food; कृतान्नमुदकं स्त्रियः [[

]]; 11. 3. 
__2 digested food. 
__3 excrement. 
-अपराध a. guilty, offender, criminal. 
-अभय a. saved from fear or danger. 
-अभिषेक a. crowned, inaugurated. (-कः) a prince. 
-अभ्यास a. practised. 
-अयः the die called कृत marked with four points. 
-अर्थ a. 
__1 having gained one's object, successful; एकः कृतार्थो भवते वीतशोकः [[Śvet.

.]] 
__2 satisfied; happy, contented; वयं कृतार्था इत्यभिमन्यन्ति बालाः [[

.]] 
__3 clever. 
__4 that which has served its purpose (and hence incapable of yielding any further sense or serving any other purpose); पुरुषे यागं श्रावयित्वा कृतार्थः शब्द एकस्य द्वयोर्बहूनां वा यागं न वारयति । [[ŚB. on
.]] सकृत् कृत्वा [Page0596-1] कृतार्थः शब्दः न नियमः पौनःपुन्ये । [[ŚB. on
]]; सा चाकाङ्क्षा एकेनापि कृतार्था भवतीत्युक्तम् । [[ŚB. on

.]] (कृतार्थीकृ 
__1 to render fruitful or successful; कृतार्थीकृत्य तं विप्रम् [[

.]] 
__2 to make good; कान्तं प्रत्युपचारतश्चतुरया कोपः कृतार्थीकृतः [[

.]]) 
-अवधान a. careful, attentive. 
-अवधि a. 
__1 fixed, appointed. 
__2 bounded, limited. 
-अवमर्ष a. 
__1 effacing from recollection. 
__2 intolerant. 
-अवस्थ a. 
__1 summoned, caused to be present; [[

.]] 
__2 fixed, settled. 
-अस्त्र a. 
__1 armed. 
__2 trained in the science of arms or missiles; पित्रा संवर्धितो नित्यं कृतास्त्रः सांपरायिकः [[

.]] 
-अहक a. having performed the daily ceremonies. 
-आगम a. advanced, proficient, skilled. (-m.) the Supreme soul. 
-आगस् a. guilty, offending, criminal, sinful; अध्ने प्र शिरो जहि ब्रह्मजस्य कृतागसः [[
]]; कृतागाः कौटिल्यो भुजग इव निर्याय नगरात् [[

.]] 
-आत्मन् a. 
__1 having control over oneself, self-possessed, of a self-governed spirit; कृतात्मा ब्रह्मलोकमभिसंभवामि [[Ch.

.]] 
__2 purified in mind; magnanimous; तमरिघ्रं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् [[

.]] 
-आभरण a. adorned. 
-आयास a. labouring, suffering. 
-आलय a. one who has taken up his abode in any place; यत्र ते दयिता भार्या तनयाश्च कृतालयाः [[Rām.]] (-यः) a frog; dog? [[MW.]] 
-आवास a lodging. 
-आस्पद a. 
__1 governed; ruled. 
__2 supporting, resting on. 
__3 residing in. 
-आहार a. having taken one's meals. 
-आह्वान a. challenged. 
-उत्साह a. diligent, making effort, striving. 
-उदक a. one who has performed his ablutions; [[

.]] 
-उद्वाह a. 
__1 married. 
__2 practising penance by standing with up-lifted hands. 
-उपकार a. 
__1 favoured, befriended, assisted; अज्ञातभर्तृव्यसना मुहूर्तं कृतोपकारेव रतिर्बभूव [[

.]] 
__2 friendly. 
-उपभोग a. used, enjoyed. 
-कर, -कारिन् a. Enjoining what is already known or done; कृतकरो हि विधिरनर्थकः स्यात् [[ŚB. on

.]] 
-कर्मन् a. 
__1 one who has done his work; [[

.]] 
__2 skilful, clever. (-m.) 
__1 the Supreme spirit. 
__2 a Saṃnyāsin. 
-काम a. one whose desires are fulfilled. 
-कार्य a. 
__1 one who has done his work or obtained his object. 
__2 having no need of another's aid. 
-काल a. 
__1 fixed or settled as to time. 
__2 who has waited a certain time. 
(-लः) appointed time; कृतशिल्पोऽपि निवसेत्कृतकालं गुरोर्गृहे [[

.]] 
-कृत्य, -क्रिय a. 
__1 who has accomplished his object; [[

.]] 
__3 clever. 
__4 having done his duty; कृतकृत्यो विधिर्मन्ये न वर्धयति तस्य ताम् [[Śi. 2. 32.]] 
-क्रयः a purchaser. 
-क्रियः 
__1 one who has accomplished any act. 
__2 one who has fulfilled his duty. 3 one who has performed a religious ceremony; [[

.]] 
-क्षण a. 
__1 waiting impatiently for the exact moment; कृतक्षणाहं भद्रं ते गमनं प्रति राघव [[

.]] 
__2 one who has got [Page0596-2] an opportunity. 
-घ्न a. 
__1 ungrateful; [[

.]] 
__2 correct in conduct; कृतज्ञतामस्य वदन्ति सम्पदः [[Ki.]] (-ज्ञः) 
__1 a dog. 
__2 an epithet of Śiva. 
-तीर्थ a. 
__1 one who has visited or frequented holy places. 
__2 one who studies with a professional teacher. 
__3 fertile in means or expedients. 
__4 a guide. 
__5 rendered accessible or easy; [[

.]] 
-दार a. married. 
-दासः a servant hired for a stated period, a hired servant. 
-दूषणम् spoiling what is done; उद्धतायाः पुनरुद्धनने न हि किञ्चित्कार्यमस्ति । केवलं कृतदूषणं भवेत् । [[ŚB. on

.]] (see कृतदूषा) 
-दूषा f. a blemish or vitiating factor for what is done; अकर्म वा कृतदूषा स्यात् [[

. ]](कृतायाः दूषणम् [[ŚB. on MS.]]). 
-धी a. 
__1 prudent, considerate. 
__2 learned, educated, wise; पुत्रेभ्यः कृतवेदिनां कृतधियां येषां न भिन्ना वयम् [[

.]] 
__2 confident, sure. 
-पुङ्ख a. skilled in archery. 
-पूर्व a. done formerly. 
-प्रतिकृतम् assault and counter-assault, attack and resistance; [[

.]] 
-प्रतिज्ञ a. 
__1 one who has made an agreement or engagement. 
__2 one who has fulfilled his promise. 
-प्रयोजन a. one who has attained his object; [[

.]] 
-फल n. successful. (-लम्) result, consequence. 
-बुद्धि a. 
__1 learned, educated, wise; विद्वत्सु कृतबुद्धयः (श्रेष्ठाः) [[

]], 7. 30. 
__2 a man of resolute character. 
__3 informed of one's duty. 
-ब्रह्मन् a. Ved. one who has performed his devotions; कृतब्रह्मा शूशुवद् रातहव्य इत् [[

.]] 
-मङ्गल a. blessed, consecrated. 
-मति a. firm, resolute. 
-मन्यु a. indignant. 
-मालः, -लकः 
__1 a kind of cassia. 
__2 the spotted antelope. 
-मुख a. learned, clever, wise. 
-युगम् the first (golden) of the four ages. 
-रूप one who knows the customary rites (कृतकल्प); [[

.]] 
-लक्षण a. 
__1 stamped, marked. 
__2 branded; ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिभिस्त्वेतास्त्यक्तव्याः कृतलक्षणाः [[

.]] 
__3 excellent, amiable. 
__4 defined, discriminated. 
-वर्मन् m. N. of a warrior on the side of the Kauravas who with Kṛpa and Aśvatthāman survived the general havoc of the great Bhārata war. He was afterwards slain by Sātyaki. 
-वापः a penitent who has shaven his head and chin; [[

.]] 
-विद् a. grateful; तस्यापवर्ग्यशरणं तव पादमूलं विस्मर्यते कृतविदा कथमार्तबन्धो [[
]]; सुवर्णपुष्पितां पृथ्वीं विचिन्वन्ति त्रयो जनाः । शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च यश्च जानाति सेवितुम् ॥ [[

.]] (-र्यः) N. of the father of Sahasrārjuna. 
-वेतन a. hired, paid (as a servant); प्रमादमृतनष्टांश्च प्रदाप्यः कृतवेतनः [[

.]] 
-वेदिन् a. 
__1 grateful; न तथा कृतवेदिनां करिष्यन्प्रियतामेति यथा कृता- [Page0597-1] -वदानः [[

.]] 
-व्यावृत्ति a. dislodged or dismissed from office, set aside; [[

.]] 
-शिल्प a. skilled in art or trade; कृतशिल्पोऽपि निवसेत्कृतकालं गुरोर्गृहे [[

.]] 
-शोभ a. 
__1 splendid. 
__2 beautiful. 
__3 handy, dexterous. 
-शौच a. purified; पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कृतशौचो भवेच्च सः [[

.]] 
-श्मश्रुः one who is shaven; न हि कृतश्मश्रुः पुनः श्मश्रूणि कारयति [[Mbh.]] on [[

.]] 
-श्रमः, -परिश्रमः one who has studied; कृतपरिश्रमोऽस्मि ज्योतिःशास्त्रे [[

.]] 
-संज्ञ a. 
__1 having presence of mind … स्थापयेद् दासान् कृतसंज्ञान् समन्ततः [[Ms.]] 
__2 restored to consciousness or senses. 
__3 aroused. 
__4 one to whom sign has been given; [[Rāj.

.]] 
-संनाह a. clad in armour, accoutred. 
-संस्कार a. 
__1 one who has performed all purificatory rites, initiated; वैश्यस्तु कृतसंस्कारः [[

.]] 
__2 Prepared, adorned. 
-सापत्निका, -सापत्नी, -सापत्नीका, -सापत्नका, सपत्निका a woman whose husband has married another wife, a married woman having a co-wife or a superseded wife. 
-हस्त, -हस्तक a. 
__1 dexterous, clever, skilful, handy. 
__2 skilled in archery. 
-हस्तता 
__1 skill, dexterity; … संनिपाते । सुमहति कृतहस्ताः सैनिकास्तं ररक्षुः ॥ [[Śiva

.]] 47. 
__2 skill in archery or generally in handling arms; कौरव्ये कृतहस्तता पुनरियं देवे यथा सीरिणि [[

p. p. 
__1 Cut, divided. 
__2 Desired, sought.

a. [कृत-कन्] 
__1 Done, made, prepared; (opp. नैसर्गिकृ); यद्यत्कृतकं तत्तदनित्यम् [[Nyāya S..]] 
__2 Artificial, done or prepared artificially; अकृतकविधि सर्वाङ्गीणमाकल्पजातम् [[

.]] 
__3 Feigned, pretended, false, sham, assumed; कृतककलहं कृत्वा [[

.]] 
__4 Adopted (as a son &c.); oft. at the end of comp. also; यस्योपान्ते कृतकतनयः कान्तया वधिंतो मे (बालमन्दारवृक्षः) [[

.]] 
-कम् 
__1 A kind of salt (Mar. बिडलोण). 
__2 Sulphate of copper. 
-कम् ind. In a simulated manner; अपयाति सरोषया निरस्ते कृतकं कामिनि चुक्षुवे मृगाक्ष्या [[Śi. 9. 83.]]
ind. Enough, no more of, away; (with instr.); अथवा कृतं संदेहेन [[Śi. 1]]; अथवा गिरा कृतम् [[
(pres. p.) a. One who has done; कृतवानसि विप्रियं न मे प्रतिकूलं न च मे त्वया कृतम् [[

f. [कृ-क्तिन्] 
__1 Doing, manufacturing, making, performing. 
__2 Action, deed. 
__3 Creation, literary work, composition; (तौ) स्वकृतिं गापयामास कविप्रथमपद्धतिम् [[

.]] 
__4 Magic, enchantment. 
__5 Injuring, killing; स कृत्या चकितो गत्वा मुनिं वव्रे पुरोहितम् [[

.]] 
__6 The number ‘20’. 
__7 An enchantress, a witch. 
__8 A knife. 
__9 Way-laying; hurting, injuring [Page0597-2] (Ved.). 
__10 A square number. 
__11 (in drama) Confirmation of any obtainment. 
-Comp. 
-करः 
__1 an epithet of Rāvaṇa. 
__2 one practising magic, a witch. 
-साध्यत्वम् the state of being accomplished by exertion.

.]] 
__2 Especially, the hide of an antelope on which a religious student sits. 
__3 The bark of the birch-tree used for writing upon &c. 
__4 The birch-tree. 
__5 One of the lunar mansions, Pleiades. 
__6 A house. 
-Comp. 
-वासः, -वासस् m. an epithet of Śiva; स कृत्तिवासास्तपसे यतात्मा [[

a. [कृतमनेन, कृत-इनि] 
__1 One who has done his work or gained his end, satisfied, contented, happy, successful; यस्य वीर्येण कृतिनो वयं च भुवनानि च [[

.]] 
__4 Good, virtuous, pure, pious; तावदेव कृतिनामपि स्फुरत्येष निर्मलविवेकदीपकः [[

.]] 
__5 Following, obeying, doing what is enjoined.

कृते,
 
-कृतेन ind. (With gen. or in comp.) For, for the sake of, on account of; अमीषां प्राणानां … कृते [[
.]] कृते किं नास्माभिर्विगलितविवेकैः … ibid. काव्यं यशसेऽर्थकृते [[K.

]]] 
__1 Working well, able to work, powerful. 
__2 Clever, skilful. 
-त्नुः A mechanic, an artist.

]]] 
__1 What should or ought to be done, right, proper, fit; साधु पर्याप्तमेतावत्कृत्यश्चारित्रसंग्रहः [[

.]] 
__2 Feasible, practicable. 
__3 One who may be seduced from allegiance, treacherous; [[Rāj.

.]] 
-त्यम् 
__1 What ought to be done, duty, (इतिकृत्य) function; [[

.]] 
-त्यः A class of affixes used to form potential (future) passive participle; these are तव्य, अनीय, य and also एलिम. 
-त्या 
__1 Action, deed. 
__2 Magic. 
__3 A female deity to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and magical purposes; परं यत्नमकरोद्यो मे पापकृत्यां शमयेदिति [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-अकृत्यरक्षणम् protection of parties for or against one's cause; [[Kau.

.]] 
-विधिः m. the rule, precept. 
-शेष a. One who has not finished his task; व्रजस्त्रियो दृग्भिरनुप्रवृत्तधियोऽवतस्थुः किल कृत्यशेषाः [[

a. 
__1 Having any business. 
__2 Having any request. 
__3 Wanting, longing for; यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः [[

]]] 
__1 The third of the 27 lunar mansions or asterisms, (consisting [Page0598-2] of 6 stars) the Pleiades; [[

.]] 
__2 The six stars represented as nymphs acting as nurses to Kārtikeya, the god of war. 
-Comp. 
-अञ्जिः a kind of horse in an Aśvamedha sacrifice having a carriage as an emblem. 
-तनयः, -पुत्रः, -सुतः epithets of Kārtikeya; अनुगच्छति देवेशं ब्रह्मण्यः कृत्तिकासुतः [[
(from कृन्त्) An instrument of an architect; अन्येषु शिल्पेषु च यान्यपि स्युः सर्वाणि कृत्यान्यखिलेन तत्र [[

]]]
